method: Hand-selected from the stored package text, NOT from any model output. Each sentence is an exact substring of the named document; its character range is recomputed at run time (a drifting anchor fails the suite). An anchor is RECOVERED when a trusted row's verified evidence (verification.found_in) overlaps the anchor's range in that document. The set is a coverage benchmark, not an exhaustive list of every obligation.

anchors.sentence: Offerors must submit their annual Vets4212 Report.

Quotes shall be emailed to Michael Spivack at

Michael.Spivack@va.gov.
Each submittal shall include project title, location, project number,  date, subcontractor name (if applicable), specification section, product identification, and revision history.
Employer's liability coverage of at least $100,000 is required, except in States with exclusive or monopolistic funds that do not permit workers' compensation to be written by private carriers.

The successful bidder must present to the Contracting Officer, prior to award, evidence of general liability insurance without any exclusionary clauses for asbestos that would void the general liability coverage.

anchors.region: base / middle — C.9 limitations on subcontracting (beyond 50K)
anchors.sentence: In the case of a contract for general construction, the contractor will not pay more than 85% of the amount paid by the government to it to firms that are not certified SDVOSBs
Submit signed and dated offers to the office specified in this solicitation at or before the exact time specified in this solicitation.

A Technical Capability Statement (maximum of five (5) pages) demonstrating the vendors ability to meet all requirements of the Statement of Work without additional cost to the Government in manpower or resources.

anchors.region: base / late — Section E 52.212-2 Factor 1 license list (beyond 50K)
anchors.sentence: Proof of current Workers' Compensation Insurance and Commercial General Liability Insurance.
A statement confirming the Contractor's ability to meet the emergency response times specified in the Statement of Work.
A staffing plan describing how demolition and asbestos abatement services to include emergency will be provided on an as-needed basis.
A waste transportation and disposal plan for asbestos-containing materials that complies with all applicable New Jersey and Federal regulations.

The Government will evaluate the Offeror's past performance based on quality of workmanship, reliability of service, compliance with contract requirements, timeliness of performance, and customer satisfaction.
